styles.intended_use: Illustrated or comic-like AI drama where stable silhouettes, readable expressions, and stylized acting are more important than live-action realism.
positive_rules: clear character silhouettes and stable facial anchors
cinematic lighting with illustrated or painterly finish
consistent costume, hair, accessories, and scene palette
negative_rules: photorealistic live-action look unless explicitly approved
anime exaggeration that changes the intended age or identity
visible captions, watermarks, logos, or UI text

review_rubric.identity: Face, hair, silhouette, costume, and signature accessories remain recognizable as the locked character.
review_rubric.style_match: The result reads as motion-comic instead of live-action photography.
review_rubric.story_readability: The shot communicates the intended beat in vertical 9:16.
review_rubric.continuity: Lighting, palette, costume, and scene remain compatible with adjacent shots.

manual_generation_notes.codex_imagegen: Ask for a colorful motion-comic still, clear line/painterly finish, stable character anchors, and no photorealistic live-action look.
manual_generation_notes.gemini_video_web: Paste the video prompt with the motion-comic style line intact; upload locked character or first/last frames when available; reject outputs that become live-action photos unless the shot has an approved override.

styles.intended_use: Actor-like vertical short-drama visuals with natural faces, practical lighting, and realistic locations while still avoiding celebrity likeness or uncontrolled identity drift.
positive_rules: natural actor-like faces without celebrity likeness
realistic lighting, lens, wardrobe, and workplace or period-drama production design
consistent hairstyle, costume, age, and body type
negative_rules: comic or anime rendering unless explicitly approved
celebrity likeness or recognizable real person
age drift, face drift, hairstyle drift, or costume drift
visible captions, watermarks, logos, or UI text

review_rubric.identity: The character feels like the same actor-like person across shots without copying a real celebrity.
review_rubric.style_match: The result reads as light live-action realism instead of comic/anime illustration.
review_rubric.story_readability: The action and emotion are readable in vertical 9:16.
review_rubric.continuity: Costume, setting, lens feel, lighting, and age remain stable across adjacent shots.

manual_generation_notes.codex_imagegen: Ask for cinematic live-action light realism, natural actor-like faces, realistic office or drama lighting, and no celebrity likeness.
manual_generation_notes.gemini_video_web: Use the live-action style line; upload first/last frames and references when available; reject outputs with celebrity likeness, face drift, or sudden comic/anime rendering.
